name: <ACCOUNT_ADDRESS>
description: The address of a Nyx account

name: <AMOUNT>
description: An amount in unyx (1 NYX is 1,000,000 unyx)

name: <ANNOUNCE_WSS_PORT>
description: Port listening to Web Secure Socket, default and recommended `9001`

name: <ARGUMENTS>
description: Replace with all flags used to run the binary with a given command

name: <BINARY>
description: A name of a binary

name: <BINARY_TYPE>
description: The directory of a binary kind under `~/.nym/`

name: <COMMAND>
description: A command: a command of the binary, or a shell command

name: <DESCRIPTION>
description: A short description of the node

name: <EMAIL>
description: An email address of the operator

name: <EXPOSE_SYSTEM_HARDWARE>
description: Specify whether basic system hardware information should be exposed. default: `true`, possible values: `true` or `false`

name: <EXPOSE_SYSTEM_INFO>
description: Specify whether basic system information should be exposed. default: `true`, possible values: `true` or `false`

name: <FAMILY_NAME>
description: The name of a node family

name: <FILE_NAME>
description: The name of a file

name: <HOSTNAME>
description: A registered DNS domain of the server, which points at its IP address

name: <HTTP_BIND_ADDRESS>
description: Socket address this node will use for binding its http API - mandatory! Must be on port `8080`!

name: <ID>
description: A local only `nym-node` identifier, specified by flag `--id`. Not mandatory as it defaults to `default-nym-node` if not specified.

name: <IDENTITY>
description: The Keybase identity of a Nyx validator

name: <ID_1>
description: The local id of a first instance, in an example directory tree

name: <ID_2>
description: The local id of a second instance, in an example directory tree

name: <ID_KEY>
description: Node public identity key, exposed on the network

name: <INTERFACE>
description: A network interface of the server, as `ip link show` lists it

name: <INVENTORY_HOST>
description: The name of a host in the Ansible inventory, for example `node1`

name: <IPINFO_API_KEY>
description: An API token of ipinfo.io

name: <ISP_IPV4_GATEWAY>
description: The IPv4 default gateway of the server, which the provider gives (in its control panel, or from `ip -4 route | grep default`)

name: <ISP_IPV6_GATEWAY>
description: The IPv6 default gateway of the server, which the provider gives (in its control panel, or from `ip -6 route | grep default`)

name: <JAIL>
description: The name of a fail2ban jail, for example `sshd`

name: <JURISDICTION_NAME>
description: The name of a jurisdiction, which is also the file name of its page

name: <KEY>
description: The file name of an SSH host key in `/etc/ssh/`

name: <KEYRING_NAME>
description: The name of a key in the `nyxd` keyring

name: <KEY_NAME>
description: The file name of a generated key pair

name: <LANDING_PAGE_ASSETS_PATH>
description: A sub-directory located at `/var/www/<HOSTNAME>` containing html configuration files

name: <LINK>
description: The download URL of a binary, from its release page

name: <LOCATION>
description: Location of your node. Formats like 'Jamaica',  or two-letter alpha2 (e.g. 'JM'), three-letter alpha3 (e.g. 'JAM') or three-digit numeric-3 (e.g. '388') can be provided.

name: <LOG_FILE>
description: The path of a log file

name: <MIXNET_BIND_ADDRESS>
description: Address to bind to for listening for mixnet packets - mandatory! Must be on port `1789`!

name: <MNEMONIC>
description: The mnemonic of a Nyx account

name: <MODE>
description: A functionality of your `nym-node` in the mixnet - mandatory! Chose from `entry-gateway`, `mixnode` or `exit-gateway`

name: <MONIKER>
description: The moniker (name) of a Nyx validator

name: <N>
description: The number of hosts that Ansible updates at the same time (`maintenance_serial`)

name: <NEW_BRANCH_NAME>
description: The name of a new git branch

name: <NODE>
description: The kind of node a command runs: `nym-node` or `validator`

name: <NODE_ID>
description: The node id of a bonded node on the chain, a number (not the local `--id`)

name: <NS_AGENT_MNEMONIC>
description: The mnemonic of the Nyx account of a node status agent

name: <NS_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY>
description: The private key of a node status agent

name: <NS_AGENT_PUBLIC_KEY>
description: The public key of a node status agent, which the node status API accepts

name: <NUMBER_OF_VIRTUAL_CPUS>
description: The number of virtual CPUs of a VM

name: <NUMBER_OF_WORKERS>
description: The number of probe workers that the script starts

name: <NYM>
description: An amount in NYM

name: <NYMVISOR_INSTANCE_ID>
description: The id of a Nymvisor instance

name: <NYM_API_CONFIG_DATA>
description: The configuration files of a `nym-api` instance

name: <NYM_API_DATA>
description: The data files of a `nym-api` instance

name: <NYM_API_HOSTNAME>
description: The DNS name of the `nym-api` of a Nyx validator, for example `nym-api.nyx.yourdomain.tld`

name: <NYM_MONOREPO_PATH>
description: The path of a clone of the Nym monorepo

name: <NYXD_VERSION>
description: Version of validator binaries

name: <NYX_API_HOSTNAME>
description: The DNS name of the REST API of a Nyx validator, for example `api.nyx.yourdomain.tld`

name: <NYX_GRPC_HOSTNAME>
description: The DNS name of the gRPC endpoint of a Nyx validator, for example `grpc.nyx.yourdomain.tld`

name: <NYX_RPC_HOSTNAME>
description: The DNS name of the RPC endpoint of a Nyx validator, for example `rpc.nyx.yourdomain.tld`

name: <OS_NAME>
description: The OS id that `virt-install --osinfo` takes

name: <PASSWORD>
description: A password the operator chooses

name: <PATH_TO>
description: Specify a full path to the given file, directory or binary behind this variable

name: <PATH_TO_BINARIES>
description: The directory of the binaries

name: <PATH_TO_EXECUTABLE>
description: The path of the binary of a Nymvisor upgrade

name: <PATH_TO_LOCAL_NGINX_CONFIGURATION_BACKUP>
description: The local copy of the nginx configuration of the server

name: <PATH_TO_LOCAL_NODE_CONFIGURATION_FOLDER>
description: The local copy of the node configuration directory

name: <PATH_TO_LOCAL_WWW_CONFIGURATION_BACKUP>
description: The local copy of `/var/www/` of the server

name: <PATH_TO_TARGET_DIRECTORY>
description: The directory that a copy goes to

name: <PAYLOAD_GENERATED_BY_THE_WALLET>
description: The contract message that the wallet shows when you bond a node

name: <PEER_HOST>
description: The host of a persistent peer of a Nyx node

name: <PEER_NODE_ID>
description: The CometBFT node id of a persistent peer

name: <PEER_PORT>
description: The P2P port of a persistent peer

name: <PLAYBOOK>
description: The name of an Ansible playbook

name: <PORT>
description: A port number

name: <PUBLIC_IP>
description: The public IPv4 address of the server (one address; `<PUBLIC_IPS>` is the list value of `--public-ips`)

name: <PUBLIC_IPS>
description: IPv4 of the `nym-node` server - mandatory! Use this address as a `host` value for bonding.Use this address as a `host` value for bonding.

name: <PUBLIC_IPV6>
description: The public IPv6 address of the node

name: <RELEASE_TAG>
description: The git tag of a release

name: <REMOTE_SUBNET>
description: The first three octets of a subnet that is not the VM network

name: <SCRIPT_NAME>
description: The name of a script

name: <SERVICE>
description: The name of a systemd service

name: <SHA_HASH>
description: The SHA-256 hash of a binary, from its release page

name: <SIZE_IN_GB>
description: A size in gigabytes

name: <SIZE_IN_MB>
description: A size in megabytes

name: <SNAPSHOT_URL>
description: The URL of a current chain snapshot

name: <SOURCE_HOST_ADDRESS>
description: The address of the server that a copy comes from

name: <SOURCE_ID>
description: The local id of the node that a copy comes from

name: <SOURCE_PATH>
description: The path that a copy comes from

name: <SOURCE_USER_NAME>
description: The Unix user on the server that a copy comes from

name: <SSH_KEY>
description: The file name of an SSH key in `~/.ssh/`

name: <SSH_KEY_ENV_VAR>
description: The name of the environment variable that holds the path of the SSH key for Ansible

name: <TARGET_HOST_ADDRESS>
description: The address of the server that a copy goes to

name: <TARGET_PATH>
description: The path that a copy goes to

name: <TARGET_USER_NAME>
description: The Unix user on the server that a copy goes to

name: <UPGRADE_NAME>
description: The name of a Nymvisor upgrade

name: <USER>
description: The Unix user on the server

name: <VALOPER_ADDRESS>
description: The operator address of a Nyx validator

name: <VERSION>
description: Version of the binary that the service runs, as its release shows it

name: <VM_IPv4>
description: The IPv4 address of a VM

name: <VM_IPv6>
description: The IPv6 address of a VM

name: <VM_NAME>
description: The name of a VM in libvirt

name: <VM_SUBNET>
description: The first three octets of the VM network (`virbr0`)

name: <WELCOME_TEXT>
description: Any text you want to show on the landing page
example: Welcome to Nym Node, operator contact is example@email.me

name: <WG_PEER_STRING_END>
description: The end of a WireGuard peer string

name: <WIREGUARD_ENABLED>
description: Specifies whether the wireguard service is enabled, possible values: `true` or `false` - `true` is recommended

name: <WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_IP>
description: Private IP address of the wireguard gateway. This mandatory field is set to a correct default: `10.1.0.1`, operators upgrading from older versions must overwrite it.
A flag added explicitly to `nym-node run` command every time, showing that the operator agreed with [T&Cs](/operators/nodes/nym-node/setup#terms--conditions)
Specify whether to write new changes - the values of other flags in the given command - to the config file
